questions.q: In which year did Croatia declare independence from Yugoslavia?
questions.why: Independence was declared on 25 June.

questions.q: What is the capital of Croatia?
questions.why: It is in the north of the country.

questions.q: In which year did Croatia join the European Union?
questions.why: It was the 28th member.

questions.q: Which inventor of alternating current was born in Smiljan, Croatia?
questions.why: He was an ethnic Serb born in the Croatian region of Lika.

questions.q: Which Roman emperor built a palace in Split?
questions.why: The old town grew inside it.

questions.q: Which 1991–95 conflict is called the Homeland War in Croatia?
questions.why: It ended with Operation Storm in 1995.

questions.q: Who was Croatia's first President?
questions.why: He led the country from 1990 to 1999.

questions.q: Which medieval king was the first crowned King of Croatia, in 925?
questions.why: A square in Zagreb is named after him.

questions.q: Which city-state on the coast was the independent Republic of Ragusa?
questions.why: It rivalled Venice in trade.

questions.q: Which 1102 agreement linked Croatia with the Kingdom of Hungary?
questions.why: Croatia kept its own institutions.

questions.q: Who became Croatia's first woman President, in 2015?
questions.why: She was popular at the 2018 World Cup.

questions.q: Which Croatian invented the mechanical pencil?
questions.why: In Croatian, a pen is still called a 'penkala'.

questions.q: Which Croatian-born police official pioneered fingerprint identification in Argentina?
questions.why: He worked in La Plata.

questions.q: Which ban (governor) of 1848 is remembered on Zagreb's main square?
questions.why: His statue faces the square named after him.

questions.q: Which Renaissance inventor designed an early parachute called 'Homo Volans'?
questions.why: He described it in 1595.

questions.q: Which walled city on the Adriatic was a filming location for 'Game of Thrones'?
questions.why: It played King's Landing.

questions.q: Which national park is famous for 16 terraced lakes and waterfalls?
questions.why: It is a UNESCO site.

questions.q: Which sea lies along Croatia's coast?
questions.why: Croatia has over 1,000 islands.

questions.q: What is Croatia's currency?
questions.why: It replaced the kuna in 2023.

questions.q: Which spotted dog breed comes from a Croatian region?
questions.why: It is named after Dalmatia.

questions.q: Which piece of men's clothing came from Croatian soldiers' scarves?
questions.why: The word 'cravat' comes from 'Croat'.

questions.q: Which team did Croatia lose to in the 2018 World Cup final?
questions.why: It was Croatia's first World Cup final.

questions.q: Which Croatian midfielder won the 2018 Ballon d'Or?
questions.why: He broke the Messi–Ronaldo run.

questions.q: Which Roman amphitheatre stands in Pula?
questions.why: It is one of the best-preserved in the world.

questions.q: Which Zadar attraction makes music from waves?
questions.why: It plays notes through pipes under the steps.

questions.q: Which hilltop truffle region lies in the northwest?
questions.why: Its white truffles are prized.

questions.q: Which national park is famous for waterfalls on the Krka River?
questions.why: Skradinski Buk is its biggest waterfall.

questions.q: Which tennis player won Wimbledon in 2001 as a wildcard?
questions.why: He was ranked 125th at the time.

questions.q: Which island is said to be the birthplace of Marco Polo?
questions.why: Venice also claims him.

questions.q: Which museum in Zagreb displays objects left after relationships ended?
questions.why: It began as a travelling exhibition.
